column1: # Device layer: GPD Win 1. Hardware fixes and tuning that only make sense on this device.
# Tab-separated. Repo paths are relative to the layer's root (devices/gpd-win1); see scripts/sync and
# docs/repo-layout.md. Kinds: link (live is a symlink into the repo), copy (repo holds a copy),
# keep (a copy the program rewrites, synced both ways with the user's say), build (C source compiled).
# Patched kernel modules, built by DKMS for every kernel (kernel/prepare.sh; docs/hardware.md "Audio",
# docs/power.md "Charging voltage"). Needs dkms and linux-headers (packages.txt) and kernel.org on install.
